;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**[[Azerbaijani Armed Forces|Azerbaijani forces]] shell the [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]] capital of [[Stepanakert]], wounding ten civilians and partially destroying several buildings, including the Artsakh Rescue Service [[headquarters]], according to [[Armenia]]n officials. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1743201/world (''Arab News'')] [https://sputniknews.com/world/202010021080639561-azerbaijan-strikes-nagorno-karabakh-capital-stepanakert-armenian-defence-ministry-says/ (Sputnik)] 

;Business and economy
*A [[consortium]] between [[Mohsin Issa|Mohsin]] and [[Zuber Issa]], owners of the British-based retailer [[EG Group|Euro Garages]], and the [[private equity]] firm [[TDR Capital]] acquire a majority stake in the supermarket chain [[Asda]] worth [[Pound sterling|£]]6.8 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]8.7 billion) from American retailer [[Walmart]]. Walmart will maintain a minority shareholding. [https://www.livemint.com/news/world/walmart-sells-uk-supermarket-asda-for-8-7-bn-11601637899018.html (AFP via ''Mint'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid]]
*****The perimeter confinement of Europe's worst hot spot, in [[Madrid]], ordered by the [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]], begins for two weeks. President of the [[Community of Madrid]] [[Isabel Díaz Ayuso]] takes legal action against the resolution. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-10-02/europe-worst-infection-hotspot-madrid-lockdown-coronavirus-covid/12724098 (ABC Australia)] [https://elpais.com/sociedad/2020-10-02/madrid-cierra-a-reganadientes-y-amenaza-con-el-caos.html (''El País'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports 238 new cases, an all-time daily high. [https://www.rtvslo.si/zdravje/novi-koronavirus/v-cetrtek-238-novih-okuzb-najvec-doslej/537816 (RTVSLO)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[White House COVID-19 outbreak]] 
*****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he and [[First Lady of the United States|First Lady]] [[Melania Trump]] [[COVID-19 testing|tested]] positive for [[COVID-19]] and are in [[quarantine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54381848 (BBC News)]
*****On the advice of his physician and "out of an abundance of caution", Trump is flown to the [[Walter Reed National Military Medical Center]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54396670 (BBC News)]
*****[[Republican National Committee]] chairwoman [[Ronna McDaniel]] tests positive for COVID-19, hours after President Trump revealed that he tested positive. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2020/10/02/ronna-mcdaniel-tests-positive-covid-coronavirus/5893687002/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
***[[Malaysia]] reported 287 new cases on Friday, all of which were found in the country and not among travellers from overseas. It is the highest number of reported cases in the country since the beginning of the outbreak. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-10-02/malaysia-reports-record-increase-in-new-coronavirus-cases (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]] reports 1,308 new confirmed cases on Wednesday, the health ministry says. This is a new record high since the beginning of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]], prompting the [[government of Tunisia|government]] to impose a nightly [[curfew]] in [[Sousse Governorate|Sousse]] and [[Monastir Governorate|Monastir]] governorates. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-tunisia-idUSKBN26N1ON (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[AstraZeneca]] announces that they would resume [[vaccine]] trials in [[Japan]]. [https://japantoday.com/category/national/update-1-astrazeneca-resumes-vaccine-trial-in-japan-in-talks-with-u.s. (''Japan Today'')]

;International relations
*[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[Australia–New Zealand relations]]
***[[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] and [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|New Zealand Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] finalise plans for a [[trans-Tasman]] "travel bubble". [[Australia]] will permit the entry of travellers from [[New Zealand]] into [[New South Wales]] and the [[Northern Territory]] if they have stayed in New Zealand for at least two weeks effective October 16. New Zealand, however, has not reciprocated any lifting of travel restrictions for Australian travellers. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/02/australia-new-zealand-travel-bubble-open-within-two-weeks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Belarus–European Union relations]], [[European Union–Turkey relations]], [[International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests]]
**The [[European Council]] agrees on sanctions against [[Belarus]]. Opposition by [[Cyprus]] is lifted by also agreeing on a warning to [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-summit/eu-leaders-break-deadlock-to-impose-sanctions-on-belarus-idUSKBN26M3YM (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/eu-leaders-overcome-cyprus-veto-agree-to-belarus-sanctions/2020/10/01/9c0a9a10-0445-11eb-b92e-029676f9ebec_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Cambodia–United States relations]]
**[[The Pentagon]] says it is "concerned" about reports that [[Cambodia]] has demolished a U.S.-funded facility at the [[Ream Naval Base]], which could be linked to [[Chinese military]] and [[economy of China|economic]] pressure on the country. The [[Center for Strategic and International Studies]] says the [[Cambodian government]] appears to have razed the building last month. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-cambodia-military/cambodia-demolished-u-s-built-facility-on-naval-base-researchers-idUKKBN26N39Q?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–Venezuela relations]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
**[[Vice President of Venezuela|Venezuela Vice President]] [[Delcy Rodríguez]] announces that [[Venezuela|the country]] will receive shipments of [[Russia]]’s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-venezuela-russia/venezuela-says-it-receives-shipment-of-russian-sputnik-v-coronavirus-vaccine-idINL1N2GT1A2 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Czech Senate election]]
**The first round of the latest [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Senate]] [[Elections in the Czech Republic|elections]] are being held in the [[Czech Republic]]. The voters can decide over the composition of a third of the Senate's 81 total seats. [https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/first-round-of-voting-for-czech-senate-elections-to-begin/ (Foreign Brief)]
*[[Islam in France]]
**[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces a crackdown on "[[Islamist]] separatism" in [[Muslims|Muslim]] communities in [[France]], saying a bill tackling Islamist separatism would be sent to [[Parliament of France|parliament]] early next year. Among the measures, will include a ban on foreign [[imam]]s, restrictions on [[home schooling]], and the creation of an "Institute of Islamology" to tackle [[Islamic fundamentalism]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-france-macron-separatism/macron-launches-crackdown-on-islamist-separatism-in-muslim-communities-idUKKBN26N20W?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Scientists reveal the image of [[Beta Pictoris c]] (β Pic c), an [[exoplanet]] that is located 63 [[light-year|light year]]s away. [https://www.sciencealert.com/this-is-the-first-direct-image-of-an-exoplanet-detected-via-a-wobbly-star (ScienceAlert)]
*[[SpaceX]] announces that they aborted a launch of a [[GPS Block III]] satellite two seconds before taking off. [https://www.cnet.com/news/spacex-aborts-launch-of-gps-space-force-satellite-with-two-seconds-to-go/ (CNET)]
